([[Washington, D.C.]]) * [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]]
([[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]]) | college = [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] (2022–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | career_start = 2024 | career_end = | years1 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024]] | team1 = [[Delaware Blue Coats]] | years2 = 2025–2026 | team2 = [[Manisa Basket]] | highlights = * Second-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] (2024) * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Freshman team (2023) }} '''Judah Jah Leone Mintz''' (born July 10, 2003) is an American professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Körfez Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse Orange]]. ==Early life and high school== Mintz grew up in [[Fort Washington, Maryland]] and initially attended [[Gonzaga College High School]].{{cite web|title=Faith, family and how Syracuse's Judah Jah Mintz got his name|url=https://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/2022/06/faith-family-form-syracuse-recruit-judah-mintzs-foundation.html|work=[[The Post-Standard]]|date=June 9, 2022|access-date=March 1, 2023}} He averaged nine points per game as a sophomore.{{cite web|first=Mike|last=Wilson|title=New to the Zoo: Judah Mintz commits to Pitt|url=https://www.cardiachill.com/2021/6/18/22540579/judah-mintz-commit-pitt-panther-basketball-2022-four-star-combo-guard-dc-oak-hill-academy-jeff-capel|website=CardiacHill.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=June 18, 2021|access-date=February 10, 2023}} During his junior season, Mintz averaged 16 points per game.{{cite web|first=Jason|last=Jordan|title=Southern JamFest: Kobe Kill List Propels Judah Mintz|url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/southern-jamfest-judah-mintz-kobe-bryant|website=SI.com|date=May 23, 2021|access-date=March 1, 2023}} He transferred to [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] in [[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]] before his senior year.{{cite web|title=A day with Judah Mintz: How did he become Syracuse's star in the making?|url=https://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/2022/06/5-am-workouts-at-age-10-syracuse-recruit-judah-mintzs-love-of-basketball-produced-incredible-work-ethic.html|work=[[The Post-Standard]]|date=June 8, 2022|access-date=February 10, 2023}} Mintz was named to the second team of the All-National Interscholastic Basketball Conference after averaging 16.8 points per game.{{cite web|title=NIBC: The conference for high school basketball's elite shows promise|url=https://www.news-press.com/story/sports/high-school/2022/04/02/nibc-conference-high-school-basketballs-elite-shows-promise/7234505001/|work=[[The News-Press]]|date=April 2, 2022|access-date=March 1, 2023}} Mintz was rated as a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]].{{cite web|title=NC State basketball pursues four-star recruit Judah Mintz 2022 class|url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2022/02/11/nc-state-basketball-recruiting-judah-mintz-kevin-keatts/6689498001/|work=[[The Fayetteville Observer]]|date=February 11, 2022|access-date=March 1, 2023}} He initially committed to playing college basketball for the [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh Panthers]] but later decommitted from the program.{{cite web|title=Four-star shooting guard Judah Mintz decommits from Pitt's class of 2022|url=https://triblive.com/sports/four-star-shooting-guard-judah-mintz-decommits-from-pitts-class-of-2022/|work=[[Pittsburgh Tribune-Review]]|date=November 10, 2021|access-date=February 10, 2023}} Mintz ultimately signed to play for the [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse Orange]].{{cite web|title=Oak Hill four-star combo guard Judah Mintz commits to Syracuse|url=https://www.news-press.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2022/03/31/oak-hill-four-star-combo-guard-judah-mintz-commits-syracuse/7236469001/|work=[[The News-Press]]|date=March 31, 2022|access-date=March 1, 2023}}" ==College career== Mintz began his freshman season at Syracuse as a starting guard.{{cite web|title=Judah Mintz's poise down the stretch helps seal win for Syracuse: 'He's not a freshman anymore'|url=https://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/2023/02/judah-mintzs-poise-down-the-stretch-helps-seal-a-win-for-syracuse-hes-not-a-freshman-any-more.html|work=[[The Post-Standard]]|date=February 15, 2023|access-date=February 15, 2023}} He earned a spot on the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC) All-Freshman team by averaging 16.3 points, 4.6 assists, and 1.8 steals per game.{{cite web|title=Colgate's Smith, Syracuse's Mintz finalists for nation's top freshman basketball honor|url=https://romesentinel.com/stories/colgates-smith-syracuses-mintz-finalists-for-nations-top-freshman-basketball-honor,170140|work=[[Rome Sentinel]]|date=March 10, 2023|access-date=March 20, 2023}} Following the season, Mintz declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web|title=Judah Mintz has declared for the NBA Draft, will retain college eligibility|url=https://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/2023/03/judah-mintz-announces-he-will-test-the-nba-waters-retain-college-eligibility.html|work=[[The Post-Standard]]|date=March 20, 2023|access-date=March 20, 2023}} However, he later withdrew from the draft and chose to return to Syracuse for his sophomore year.{{cite web|first=Brent|last=Axe|title=Axe: Judah Mintz made the right call coming back to Syracuse|url=https://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/2023/06/axe-judah-mintz-made-the-right-call-coming-back-to-syracuse.html|work=[[The Post-Standard]]|date=June 1, 2023|access-date=June 2, 2023}} On April 11, 2024, Mintz declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web|title=Judah Mintz, Syracuse's top scorer, pursuing NBA, SU confirms|url=https://spectrumlocalnews.com/nys/central-ny/news/2024/04/11/judah-mintz--syracuse-s-top-scorer--pursuing-nba--su-confirms|work=[[Spectrum News]]|date=April 13, 2024|access-date=April 13, 2024}}" ==Professional career== ===Delaware Blue Coats (2024–2025)=== After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Mintz signed an [[Exhibit 10]] contract with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] on September 1, 2024,{{cite web|title=Philadelphia 76ers Sign Judah Mintz|url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/philadelphia-76ers-sign-judah-mintz|website=NBA.com|date=September 1, 2024|access-date=September 1, 2024}} but was waived on October 17.{{cite web|first=Arthur|last=Hill|title=Sixers Waive Four Players|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/sixers-waive-four-players.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 17, 2024|access-date=October 19, 2024}} On October 28, he joined the [[Delaware Blue Coats]].{{cite tweet|author=Delaware Blue Coats|title=ready for camp.🫡 #GetYourCoatsOn|number=1850954040386986467|user=blue_coats|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=November 3, 2024}} ===Körfez Basket
